description: Voting commands: create, edit, delete draft, open, cast, close, conclude.
precondition: Meeting in a voting status; chair or manager actor.

preconditions: Meeting Approved; actor is the current Secretary.
cases.inputs: operation: Create; Title: "Chọn địa điểm họp"; Options: ["Hà Nội", "Đà Nẵng"]; IsAnonymous: false; EligibleRoles: ["Chair", "Member"]; OpenImmediately: false.
cases.return: Success; VoteId of the new Draft vote; options saved at positions 1 and 2; MSG210.
cases.log: Draft vote row with creator = actor; DraftCreated event published to Chair and Secretary only.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; Open vote with options A and B; voter is on the eligible list; public ballot; no vote documents.
cases.return: Success; MSG227; one receipt and one choice stored for the voter; option A count +1.
cases.log: Ballot saved; BallotCast event published (never names the voter).

preconditions: Meeting InProgress; Open vote; actor was not on the list fixed at opening (joined later).
Meeting InProgress; Open vote with 3 ballots; actor is the Chair.
cases.return: Success; MSG229; status Closed, ClosedAt = now; the result (ballot count and per-option counts and percentages) is returned.

preconditions: Closed vote without a conclusion; actor is the Chair; meeting Ended.
cases.inputs: operation: Conclude (RecordConclusion); Conclusion: "Passed"; Note: "  Thống nhất  ".
cases.return: Success; MSG235; conclusion Passed, note "Thống nhất", concluded by the Chair at now.
